name: Saramaed Crossing
desc:
The Saramaed Crossing is a giant, broken passage, located between the [Miner's Landing](location:miners_landing) and the [Starfield Veldt](location:starfield_veldt). The passage has a number of static Brainsucker spawns, and a random encounter with 2 Summer Company Guards fighting a Mechalodaunt.

Inside a tower on the left side at the end of the bridge can be found [Adar, Master of Metal](entity:adar_master_of_metal), who serves as both an Ironsing trainer and a part of Silentheart progression.

The player will have to use the glider in order to get from the end of the passage to the [Starfield Veldt](location:starfield_veldt).
